//! Handles stratification of Datalog programs

use petgraph::{algo, graphmap::DiGraphMap};
use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::slice::Iter;
use syn::Ident;

pub struct Strata {
    list: Vec<Vec<Ident>>,
    index: HashMap<Ident, usize>,
}

impl Strata {
    pub fn new(relations: HashSet<Ident>, dependencies: HashSet<(&Ident, &Ident)>) -> Self {
            unimplemented!("carved out by swe-task-forge")
        }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> Iter<'_, Vec<Ident>> {
        self.list.iter()
    }

    pub fn find_relation(&self, rel: &Ident) -> usize {
        *self.index.get(rel).expect("key not found in stratum index")
    }
}

Implemented `src/strata.rs::Strata::new`.

**What it does:** builds a `DiGraphMap<&Ident, ()>` with a node per relation (so isolated relations still get a stratum) and an edge `goal -> fact` per dependency, then runs `algo::tarjan_scc`. Each SCC becomes one stratum (mutually recursive relations evaluate together), and Tarjan returns SCCs in reverse topological order, so a relation always lands in a stratum *after* everything it depends on — which is what `lib.rs` relies on for `assert!(goal_stratum > fact_stratum)` on negated clauses and for the "creates a dependency cycle" abort when the strata are equal. `index` maps each cloned `Ident` to its position in `list`.

**Tests written** (`mod strata_carve_tests` in `src/strata.rs`, 9 cases): isolated relations, empty program, index/list consistency, chain ordering, mutual recursion sharing a stratum, self-loop, diamond ordering, unknown-relation panic message, span-insensitive lookup.

FROM peb-remake/ekzhang-crepe:hardened

# These images end on a non-root USER, so a RUN inherits it and the layer below cannot write.
USER root

# the carve: every function body in the target file becomes a throwing statement
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > 'src/strata.rs'

# and the tests that describe it go too -- writing tests is part of the task
RUN set -eu; cd /workspace; \
    rm -f 'tests/test_showcase_all_features.rs'; \
    rm -f 'tests/test_transitive_closure.rs'; \
    true

# the history holds the file that was carved out; seal it away from the agent
RUN set -u; if [ -e /workspace/.git ]; then mkdir -p /root/.forge-sealed-git && mv /workspace/.git /root/.forge-sealed-git/git; fi; rm -rf /workspace/.git

WORKDIR /workspace
